# Copilot harness contract

This repository was generated by an Open Horizons Golden Path. The primitives
below were selected for **Model and agent evaluation pipeline with datasets, metrics, and regression gates.**

| Kind | Discovery path | Consumed by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Repository instructions | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | Every Copilot request |
| Path instructions | `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` | Requests touching matched files |
| Agents | `.github/agents/*.agent.md` | Agent selection and delegation |
| Skills | `.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` | Procedures a model can invoke |
| Prompts | `.github/prompts/*.prompt.md` | Explicit VS Code actions |
| Hooks | `.github/hooks/*.json` | Trusted-workspace lifecycle events |
| Agent guidance | `AGENTS.md` | Copilot CLI and other AGENTS.md readers |

## Boundaries

- `.github/prompts/*.prompt.md` are VS Code actions. Copilot CLI does not
  discover them as slash commands.
- Hooks run only in a workspace the user has marked trusted. An untrusted
  workspace silently disables them, so a hook is never a security boundary.
- `~/.copilot/` is user-level configuration and is not part of this repository.

## Validation

```bash
python3 .github/scripts/validate-primitives.py
```

## Provenance

Primitives were vendored from `Ohorizons/harness-primitives` at `15ddb04c8314d8fcdc4d3cb6fd7107a235eec457`.
Regenerate them in the Golden Path catalog with
`python3 scripts/build-primitives.py --build`; do not edit vendored files here,
because the next regeneration overwrites them.
